structured.answer: Open an account at Psagot and buy the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) tracker, which the page marks "הזול". With 10,000 now and 500 a month for 10 years I'd end up with about 86,492 ₪ (70,000 put in), or about 101,000 ₪ if I put in 600 a month.
